from: live test 2, plan v3 after the person asked again in chat: S5 an uneven cluster of about 60 dots

shots.summary: A wide grid of small neutral dots; on "selected by lottery" a scatter of dots lights gold in seeded random order and gathers into an uneven, overlapping cluster inside a thin gold ring; label "Selected by lottery"
shots.action: 16.9 s (frame starts covered in bright teal from the wipe, which clears to the right): a wide grid of small slate dots, too many to count at a glance, fades up across the upper two thirds of the frame. 21.3 s: about 60 scattered dots turn gold (#F2B705) one after another, seeded random order (seed fixed in code), about 25ms apart, too many and too fast to count. 21.6 s: label "Selected by lottery" (Display Sans 900, 68px, white, on a navy box so it reads over the grid) appears centred under where the ring will form. 23.0 to 24.4 s: the gold dots glide to centre (900ms, ease-out cubic) and settle as one uneven cluster: seeded random positions, sizes 18 to 30px, overlapping, each with a thin navy edge so it still reads as many people, never as a countable row or ring. 23.6 s: a thin gold circle line (radius 200px) fades in around the cluster. The rest of the grid dims to 15%. 24.4 s: source line "Source: Example Town, example.org" directly under the label, in the same navy box. Hold. No number anywhere.
shots.transition_out: Cross-fade 400ms; the gold ring returns in S7
reads: 23.0 to 24.4 s: gold dots gather into an overlapping cluster inside the gold ring

source_line.position: directly under the label "Selected by lottery", in the same navy box

shots.notes: Dots are residents, illustrative: no count or number shown, seeded random order so every render matches. v3 (the reviewer): the selected group is an uneven overlapping cluster inside the ring, not an evenly spaced ring of dots people could count; the source line sits directly under the label.
